title: minimal bid-redirect feed object {bid, redirecturl, campaignid}, response only

source.name: ortbtools Bid-Redirect Feed response validator (packages/core/rules-feed.js validateBidRedirectFeed) — the product's own documented minimal redirect-feed shape ({bid, redirecturl, campaignid}); no matching request-side decoder is registered in this product for any known redirect-feed GET shape, so only the response side is exercised (design.md: never invent an OpenRTB or undecodable request for a feed)
source.version: repo HEAD at session start, commit a61fc25
source.license: Internal product code (ortbtools); no third-party material copied. MIT for the original fixture values.
source.notes: packages/core/decoders/request/index.js registers exactly three request decoders (url-clickunder-feed /feed, url-search-feed /search, url-linkfeed /link); none match a redirect-feed-style GET path, so no vendor-attributed request string exists for this response shape in this product today.

modifications: bid, redirecturl and campaignid values independently authored.
advertiser.example.test is a reserved .test host; fixture-campaign-42 is a clearly synthetic campaign identifier.
provenance.sanitized: No real visitor, publisher or subscriber data. The destination host is a reserved .test name; the campaign id is a synthetic-fixture string.

pairApplicability.note: No registered request decoder exists in this product for a redirect-feed-style GET request; per design.md, the case does not invent one and stays response-only.

specNotes: packages/core/detect.js's unique discriminator for this shape is the lowercase, no-underscore key `redirecturl` (detect.js:191); packages/core/rules-feed.js validateBidRedirectFeed then requires bid (number, present: 0.18) and redirecturl (string, present) and treats campaignid as optional-but-typed (string or number, present here as a string) — zero findings expected.

detectFormat's detectFeedFormat tags FORMATS.POPS via `hasRedirect && !hasImage && !hasTitle` (format-detect.js:210-219) — this object has neither an image nor a title key, so the redirect-only branch fires cleanly.

Preview: findAdm/findPushMaterial recognize neither `redirecturl` nor `campaignid` (findAdm only reads adm/iurl; findPushMaterial requires a price key plus a click key plus a creative key, and this object has no click_url/link/title/description/image key at all) — the current preview shows the top-level empty state instead of the destination as inert text, the same root cause already recorded as DEF-202 for the sibling wire-wrapper cases.
Browser preview must not open a real popup or dispatch tracking.
notes: response-only per design.md: no request decoder in this product recognizes any redirect-feed-style GET shape, so no request payload is included rather than inventing one that would only reproduce an already-recorded no_decoder gap.

preview.limitation: A pop wrapper carries a destination, not markup: the preview resolves it and shows it as inert text with an explanation. It is never navigated to or rendered — the sealed frame's contract, not a lookup failure.
